children: may retest support at $103.83 per barrel, a break below which could trigger a fall into the $101.87-$102.85 range.
A wedge was confirmed as a top pattern, suggesting a reversal of the uptrend from $85.42 and a bearish target of $101.87.

Resistance is at $106.02, a break above which may lead to a gain into a wide range of $107.01-$108.59. On the daily chart, the resistance at $110.24, the 100% projection level of a wave C, proved to be strong.

It is not very clear that this wave has ended, as the $100.24 level serves as one of its endpoints. However, it is certain that a correction is developing towards $102.67, assuming it is the same degree as the one from August 21 high of $94.83.
Whether the market leaves the rising channel and falls deeply is subject to a further observation.
